production_rules.format: 1080 x 1920, 30 fps, H.264; no audio track
production_rules.caption_treatment: Burn in the exact spoken text, revealed word by word. Highlight key_word in Lime #B8FF5A. Keep each spoken line at ten words or fewer. The hook cover may show the whole hook; the video hook reveals it progressively.
production_rules.broll: Faceless real-world free-for-commercial-use Pexels or Pixabay stock only. Use portrait detail crops that exclude faces and bank/lender logos. Stock locations are unverified and never labelled as Indian.
production_rules.motion: Change clip, crop, zoom or kinetic text at every scene boundary; no static card longer than three seconds.
production_rules.full_disclaimer: CredNest is an advisory firm, not a lender. Loan approval and terms are at the lender's sole discretion.
production_rules.end_card: 25-28 seconds. Display the single WhatsApp CTA, supplied CredNest logo, full brand anchor and full disclaimer together within the safe zone. Narrate only the CTA. Allow a subtle moving background or slow zoom; keep all text continuously visible.
